name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minor_minimum
statement:
theorem actual_minor_minimum (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) = minorListMinimum v a x y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [all_two_by_two_minors a x y z ha]
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp only [minorListMinimum, le_min_iff]
    have h := matrixMinimum_le_entry v
      (!![a, a * x, a * y, -a * y, -a * z, a * (y ^ 2 - x * z);
         0, a⁻¹, 0, 0, 0, -z / a;
         0, 0, 1, 0, 0, y;
         0, 0, 0, 1, 0, -y;
         0, 0, 0, 0, a, a * x;
         0, 0, 0, 0, 0, a⁻¹] : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) K)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨by simpa using h 2 2, by simpa using h 0 0⟩,
      by simpa using h 1 1⟩, by simpa using h 0 1⟩, by simpa using h 2 5⟩,
      by simpa using h 0 2⟩, by simpa using h 0 4⟩,
      by simpa [neg_div] using h 1 5⟩, by simpa using h 0 5⟩
  · apply (le_matrixMinimum_iff v _ _).mpr
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [minorListMinimum, neg_div]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.twice_entry_minimum_le_minor
statement:
theorem twice_entry_minimum_le_minor (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K) :
    matrixMinimum v A + matrixMinimum v A ≤ matrixMinimum v (secondCompound A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_matrixMinimum_iff v _ _).mpr
  intro i j
  apply v.map_le_sub
  · rw [v.map_mul]
    exact add_le_add (matrixMinimum_le_entry v A _ _) (matrixMinimum_le_entry v A _ _)
  · rw [v.map_mul]
    exact add_le_add (matrixMinimum_le_entry v A _ _) (matrixMinimum_le_entry v A _ _)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_entry_minimum_le_zero
statement:
theorem actual_entry_minimum_le_zero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) : matrixMinimum v (g a x y z) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_entry_minimum]
  simp [entryListMinimum]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minor_minimum_le_zero
statement:
theorem actual_minor_minimum_le_zero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_minor_minimum v a x y z ha]
  simp [minorListMinimum]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minima_finite
statement:
theorem actual_minima_finite (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    matrixMinimum v (g a x y z) ≠ ⊤ ∧
      matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (actual_entry_minimum_le_zero v a x y z)
  · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (actual_minor_minimum_le_zero v a x y z ha)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_entry_minimum_integer_zero
statement:
theorem actual_entry_minimum_integer_zero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y : K) (k j h : ℤ) (hk : v a = k) (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) :
    matrixMinimum v (g a x y 0) = (entryMinimum 0 k j h : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_entry_minimum]
  simp [entryListMinimum, entryMinimum, baseMinimum, hk, hj, hh, min_assoc]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minor_minimum_integer_zero
statement:
theorem actual_minor_minimum_integer_zero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y : K) (k j h c : ℤ) (hk : v a = k) (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y 0)) = (minorMinimum 0 k j h c : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_minor_minimum v a x y 0 ha]
  simp [minorListMinimum, minorMinimum, baseMinimum, hk, hj, hh, two_nsmul, two_mul]
  simp only [add_min, min_assoc]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_entry_minimum_integer_nonzero
statement:
theorem actual_entry_minimum_integer_nonzero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (r k j h : ℤ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hk : v a = k) (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) (hz : v z = (-r : ℤ)) :
    matrixMinimum v (g a x y z) = (entryMinimum r k j h : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_entry_minimum]
  simp [entryListMinimum, entryMinimum, baseMinimum, hr, hk, hj, hh, hz, min_assoc]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minor_minimum_integer_nonzero
statement:
theorem actual_minor_minimum_integer_nonzero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (r k j h c : ℤ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hk : v a = k) (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) (hz : v z = (-r : ℤ))
    (hd : v (y ^ 2 - x * z) = (determinantValuation r j h c : WithTop ℤ)) :
    matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) = (minorMinimum r k j h c : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_minor_minimum v a x y z ha]
  unfold minorListMinimum
  rw [v.map_mul a (y ^ 2 - x * z), hd]
  simp [minorMinimum, baseMinimum, hr, hk, hj, hh, hz, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
  simp only [add_min, min_assoc, add_comm]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.nonzero_of_integer_valuation
statement:
theorem nonzero_of_integer_valuation (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (x : K) (k : ℤ) (hk : v x = k) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  simp [hx] at hk

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_determinant_valuation
statement:
theorem actual_determinant_valuation (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (x y z : K) (r j h c : ℤ)
    (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) (hz : v z = (-r : ℤ))
    (hc : 2 * h = j - r → v (y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1) = c) :
    v (y ^ 2 - x * z) = (determinantValuation r j h c : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hxx := nonzero_of_integer_valuation v x j hj
  have hzz := nonzero_of_integer_valuation v z (-r) hz
  have hy2 : v (y ^ 2) = ((2 * h : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
    simp [hh, two_nsmul, two_mul]
  have hxz : v (x * z) = ((j - r : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
    simp [hj, hz, sub_eq_add_neg]
  by_cases heq : 2 * h = j - r
  · have hfactor : y ^ 2 - x * z = (x * z) * (y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hfactor, v.map_mul, hc heq, hxz, ← heq]
    simp [determinantValuation, heq]
  · have hne : v (y ^ 2) ≠ v (x * z) := by
      rw [hy2, hxz]
      exact_mod_cast heq
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, v.map_add_of_distinct_val (by simpa using hne), v.map_neg,
      hy2, hxz]
    simp [determinantValuation, heq]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_cancellation_depth_nonnegative
statement:
theorem actual_cancellation_depth_nonnegative (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (x y z : K) (r j h c : ℤ)
    (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) (hz : v z = (-r : ℤ))
    (heq : 2 * h = j - r) (hc : v (y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1) = c) : 0 ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have hratio : v (y ^ 2 / (x * z)) = 0 := by
    have hval : v (y ^ 2 / (x * z)) = ((2 * h - (j - r) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
      simp [hj, hh, hz, two_nsmul, two_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [hval, heq]
    simp
  have hv := v.map_sub (y ^ 2 / (x * z)) 1
  rw [hratio, v.map_one, min_self, hc] at hv
  exact_mod_cast hv

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minima_integer_nonzero
statement:
theorem actual_minima_integer_nonzero (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (r k j h c : ℤ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hk : v a = k) (hj : v x = j) (hh : v y = h) (hz : v z = (-r : ℤ))
    (hc : 2 * h = j - r → v (y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1) = c) :
    matrixMinimum v (g a x y z) = (entryMinimum r k j h : WithTop ℤ) ∧
      matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) =
        (minorMinimum r k j h c : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨actual_entry_minimum_integer_nonzero v a x y z r k j h hr hk hj hh hz,
    actual_minor_minimum_integer_nonzero v a x y z r k j h c hr
      (nonzero_of_integer_valuation v a k hk) hk hj hh hz
      (actual_determinant_valuation v x y z r j h c hj hh hz hc)⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.cartanEliminator_symplectic
statement:
theorem cartanEliminator_symplectic (d b₁ b₂ c : K) :
    (cartanEliminator d b₁ b₂ c).transpose * J * cartanEliminator d b₁ b₂ c = J
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cartanEliminator, J, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.elementary_right_reduction
statement:
theorem elementary_right_reduction (d b₁ b₂ c p q r s u w : K) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hsp : (firstColumnShape d b₁ b₂ c p q r s u w).transpose * J *
      firstColumnShape d b₁ b₂ c p q r s u w = J) :
    p * s - q * r = 1 ∧
      firstColumnShape d b₁ b₂ c p q r s u w * cartanEliminator d b₁ b₂ c =
        !![d, 0, 0, 0; 0, p, q, 0; 0, r, s, 0; 0, 0, 0, d⁻¹]
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K => A 1 2) hsp
  have hb₁ := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K => A 1 3) hsp
  have hb₂ := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K => A 2 3) hsp
  simp [firstColumnShape, J, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hdet hb₁ hb₂
  have hdu : d * u - p * b₂ + q * b₁ = 0 := by
    field_simp at hb₁ hb₂
    linear_combination -d * u * hdet - p * hb₂ + q * hb₁
  have hdw : d * w - r * b₂ + s * b₁ = 0 := by
    field_simp at hb₁ hb₂
    linear_combination -d * w * hdet - r * hb₂ + s * hb₁
  constructor
  · linear_combination hdet
  · ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [firstColumnShape, cartanEliminator, Matrix.mul_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> field_simp <;>
      (solve | ring | linear_combination hdu | linear_combination hdw)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelShellCoordinates_of_minima
statement:
theorem kernelShellCoordinates_of_minima (p : KernelPoint K) (r k j h c : ℤ)
    (he : matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K) (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2) =
      (entryMinimum r k j h : WithTop ℤ))
    (hm : matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
      (secondCompound (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)) =
        (minorMinimum r k j h c : WithTop ℤ)) :
    KernelShellCoordinates K p r k j h c
proof:
:= by
  have he' : kernelEntryIndex K p = entryMinimum r k j h := by
    apply WithTop.coe_injective
    exact (actualEntryInteger_coe _ _ _ _ _).trans he
  have hm' : kernelMinorIndex K p = minorMinimum r k j h c := by
    apply WithTop.coe_injective
    exact (actualMinorInteger_coe _ _ _ _ _).trans hm
  have hcartan := kernel_indices_of_minima K p r k j h c he hm
  have hell : kernelEll K p = (cartanIndices r k j h c).1 := congrArg Prod.fst hcartan
  have hb : kernelB K p = (cartanIndices r k j h c).2 := congrArg Prod.snd hcartan
  have hn : kernelN K p = (cartanIndices r k j h c).1 / 2 := by
    rw [← hell, kernel_half_ell]
  refine ⟨he', hm', hell, hn, hb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold kernelHeight
    rw [hn, hb]
  · rw [kernel_height_eq, he']

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelShellCoordinates_zero
statement:
theorem kernelShellCoordinates_zero (a : Kˣ) (x y : K) (k j h : ℤ)
    (hk : localFieldValuation K (a : K) = (k : WithTop ℤ))
    (hj : localFieldValuation K x = (j : WithTop ℤ))
    (hh : localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ)) :
    KernelShellCoordinates K (a,x,y,0) 0 k j h 0
proof:
:= by
  apply kernelShellCoordinates_of_minima K (a,x,y,0) 0 k j h 0
  · exact actual_entry_minimum_integer_zero (localFieldValuation K) (a:K) x y k j h
      hk hj hh
  · exact actual_minor_minimum_integer_zero (localFieldValuation K) (a:K) x y k j h 0
      hk hj hh (Units.ne_zero a)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelShellCoordinates_nonzero
statement:
theorem kernelShellCoordinates_nonzero (a : Kˣ) (x y z : K)
    (r k j h : ℤ) (c : ℕ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hk : localFieldValuation K (a : K) = (k : WithTop ℤ))
    (hj : localFieldValuation K x = (j : WithTop ℤ))
    (hh : localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ))
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = ((-r : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ))
    (hc : 2*h = j-r → localFieldValuation K (y^2/(x*z)-1) = ((c:ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)) :
    KernelShellCoordinates K (a,x,y,z) r k j h c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he,hm⟩ := actual_minima_integer_nonzero (localFieldValuation K)
    (a:K) x y z r k j h c hr hk hj hh hz hc
  exact kernelShellCoordinates_of_minima K (a,x,y,z) r k j h c he hm

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelShell_nonzero_locus
statement:
theorem kernelShell_nonzero_locus (x y z : K) (r j h : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hj : localFieldValuation K x = (j : WithTop ℤ))
    (hh : localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ))
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = ((-r : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ))
    (hc : 2*h = j-r → localFieldValuation K (y^2/(x*z)-1) = ((c:ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)) :
    x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ z ≠ 0 ∧ y^2-x*z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := actual_determinant_valuation (localFieldValuation K) x y z r j h c
    hj hh hz hc
  exact ⟨nonzero_of_integer_valuation _ _ _ hj,
    nonzero_of_integer_valuation _ _ _ hh, nonzero_of_integer_valuation _ _ _ hz,
    nonzero_of_integer_valuation _ _ _ hd⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem extendedNegLog_zero : extendedNegLog 0 = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_exp
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendedNegLog_exp (n : ℤ) :
    extendedNegLog (WithZero.exp n) = ((-n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_one
statement: @[simp] theorem extendedNegLog_one : extendedNegLog 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((-(0 : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = 0
  simp only [neg_zero, WithTop.coe_zero]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_mul
statement:
theorem extendedNegLog_mul (x y : ℤᵐ⁰) :
    extendedNegLog (x * y) = extendedNegLog x + extendedNegLog y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using WithZero.expRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | exp a =>
    induction y using WithZero.expRecOn with
    | zero => simp
    | exp b =>
      rw [← WithZero.exp_add]
      change ((-(a + b) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((-a : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((-b : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      rw [← WithTop.coe_add]
      congr 1
      omega

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_antitone
statement: theorem extendedNegLog_antitone : Antitone extendedNegLog
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  induction x using WithZero.expRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | exp a =>
    induction y using WithZero.expRecOn with
    | zero => simp at h
    | exp b =>
      change ((-b : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ ((-a : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (neg_le_neg (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp h))

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_max
statement:
theorem extendedNegLog_max (x y : ℤᵐ⁰) :
    extendedNegLog (max x y) = min (extendedNegLog x) (extendedNegLog y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h, min_eq_right (extendedNegLog_antitone h)]
  · rw [max_eq_left h, min_eq_left (extendedNegLog_antitone h)]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.extendedNegLog_nonnegative
statement:
theorem extendedNegLog_nonnegative (x : ℤᵐ⁰) :
    0 ≤ extendedNegLog x ↔ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction x using WithZero.expRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | exp n =>
    change ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ ((-n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      WithZero.exp n ≤ WithZero.exp (0 : ℤ)
    rw [WithTop.coe_le_coe, WithZero.exp_le_exp]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.discreteValuation_surjective
statement: theorem discreteValuation_surjective : Function.Surjective (discreteValuation K)
proof:
:=
  (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K).surjective.comp
    ValuativeRel.valuation_surjective

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.localFieldValuation_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem localFieldValuation_zero : localFieldValuation K 0 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (localFieldValuation K).map_zero

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.localFieldValuation_ne_top
statement:
theorem localFieldValuation_ne_top (x : K) :
    localFieldValuation K x ≠ ⊤ ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (localFieldValuation K).ne_top_iff

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.localFieldValuation_surjective
statement: theorem localFieldValuation_surjective : Function.Surjective (localFieldValuation K)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => exact ⟨0, localFieldValuation_zero K⟩
  | coe n =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := discreteValuation_surjective K (WithZero.exp (-n))
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change extendedNegLog (discreteValuation K x) = (n : WithTop ℤ)
    rw [hx]
    change ((-(-n) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = (n : WithTop ℤ)
    rw [neg_neg]

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff
statement:
theorem localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff (x : K) :
    0 ≤ localFieldValuation K x ↔ x ∈ (ValuativeRel.valuation K).integer
proof:
:= by
  change 0 ≤ extendedNegLog (discreteValuation K x) ↔ ValuativeRel.valuation K x ≤ 1
  rw [extendedNegLog_nonnegative]
  change IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K
    (ValuativeRel.valuation K x) ≤ 1 ↔ _
  rw [← map_one (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K)]
  exact map_le_map_iff (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actual_minor_minimum_le_entry
statement:
theorem actual_minor_minimum_le_entry (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a x y z : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z)) ≤ matrixMinimum v (g a x y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actual_minor_minimum v a x y z ha, actual_entry_minimum]
  have hz : minorListMinimum v a x y z ≤ v z := by
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (v.ne_top_iff.mpr ha)
    have hva : v a = (k : WithTop ℤ) := hk.symm
    have hvi : v a⁻¹ = ((-k : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by simp [hva]
    rcases le_total k 0 with h | h
    · have hka : v a ≤ 0 := by rw [hva]; exact_mod_cast h
      have he : v (a*z) ≤ v z := by
        rw [v.map_mul]
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hka (v z)
      exact le_trans (by simp [minorListMinimum]) he
    · have hka : v a⁻¹ ≤ 0 := by
        rw [hvi]
        exact_mod_cast neg_nonpos.mpr h
      have he : v (z/a) ≤ v z := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, v.map_mul]
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hka (v z)
      exact le_trans (by simp [minorListMinimum]) he
  simp only [entryListMinimum, le_min_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨by simp [minorListMinimum], by simp [minorListMinimum]⟩,
    by simp [minorListMinimum]⟩, by simp [minorListMinimum]⟩,
    by simp [minorListMinimum]⟩, by simp [minorListMinimum]⟩, hz⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actualEntryInteger_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem actualEntryInteger_coe (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a : Kˣ) (x y z : K) :
    (actualEntryInteger v a x y z : WithTop ℤ) = matrixMinimum v (g a x y z)
proof:
:=
  WithTop.coe_untop _ _

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actualMinorInteger_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem actualMinorInteger_coe (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a : Kˣ) (x y z : K) :
    (actualMinorInteger v a x y z : WithTop ℤ) =
      matrixMinimum v (secondCompound (g a x y z))
proof:
:=
  WithTop.coe_untop _ _

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.actualInteger_bounds
statement:
theorem actualInteger_bounds (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ))
    (a : Kˣ) (x y z : K) :
    2 * actualEntryInteger v a x y z ≤ actualMinorInteger v a x y z ∧
    actualMinorInteger v a x y z ≤ actualEntryInteger v a x y z ∧
    actualEntryInteger v a x y z ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := twice_entry_minimum_le_minor v (g (a:K) x y z)
  have h2 := actual_minor_minimum_le_entry v (a:K) x y z (Units.ne_zero a)
  have h3 := actual_entry_minimum_le_zero v (a:K) x y z
  rw [← actualEntryInteger_coe v a x y z,
    ← actualMinorInteger_coe v a x y z, ← WithTop.coe_add] at h1
  rw [← actualEntryInteger_coe v a x y z,
    ← actualMinorInteger_coe v a x y z] at h2
  rw [← actualEntryInteger_coe v a x y z] at h3
  have h1' := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp h1
  have h2' := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp h2
  have h3' : actualEntryInteger v a x y z ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h3
  exact ⟨by omega, h2', h3'⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_indices_nonnegative
statement:
theorem kernel_indices_nonnegative (p : KernelPoint K) :
    0 ≤ kernelN K p ∧ 0 ≤ kernelB K p ∧ 0 ≤ kernelEll K p ∧ 0 ≤ kernelHeight K p
proof:
:= by
  have h := actualInteger_bounds (localFieldValuation K) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2
  simp only [kernelEll, kernelHeight, kernelN, kernelB, kernelEntryIndex, kernelMinorIndex]
  omega

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_height_eq
statement:
theorem kernel_height_eq (p : KernelPoint K) :
    kernelHeight K p = -kernelEntryIndex K p
proof:
:= by
  unfold kernelHeight kernelN kernelB
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_half_ell
statement: theorem kernel_half_ell (p : KernelPoint K) : kernelEll K p / 2 = kernelN K p
proof:
:= by
  unfold kernelEll
  omega

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_indices_of_minima
statement:
theorem kernel_indices_of_minima (p : KernelPoint K) (r k j h c : ℤ)
    (he : matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K) (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2) =
      (entryMinimum r k j h : WithTop ℤ))
    (hm : matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
      (secondCompound (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)) =
        (minorMinimum r k j h c : WithTop ℤ)) :
    (kernelEll K p, kernelB K p) = cartanIndices r k j h c
proof:
:= by
  have he' : kernelEntryIndex K p = entryMinimum r k j h := by
    apply WithTop.coe_injective
    exact (actualEntryInteger_coe _ _ _ _ _).trans he
  have hm' : kernelMinorIndex K p = minorMinimum r k j h c := by
    apply WithTop.coe_injective
    exact (actualMinorInteger_coe _ _ _ _ _).trans hm
  unfold kernelEll kernelN kernelB cartanIndices
  rw [he',hm']
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · ring
  · trivial

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_localFieldValuation_measurable
statement: theorem kernel_localFieldValuation_measurable : Measurable (localFieldValuation K)
proof:
:=
  FourierJacobi.Measure.canonicalValuation_measurable K

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_entry_minimum_measurable
statement:
theorem kernel_entry_minimum_measurable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (a x y z : α → K) (ha : Measurable a) (hx : Measurable x)
    (hy : Measurable y) (hz : Measurable z) :
    Measurable (fun p => matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
      (g (a p) (x p) (y p) (z p)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [actual_entry_minimum]
  unfold entryListMinimum
  have hv := kernel_localFieldValuation_measurable K
  have hzero : Measurable (fun _ : α => (0 : WithTop ℤ)) := measurable_const
  have h0 := (hzero.min (hv.comp ha)).min (hv.comp ha.inv)
  have h1 := (h0.min (hv.comp (ha.mul hx))).min (hv.comp hy)
  exact (h1.min (hv.comp (ha.mul hy))).min (hv.comp hz)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernel_minor_minimum_measurable
statement:
theorem kernel_minor_minimum_measurable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (a x y z : α → K) (ha : Measurable a) (hx : Measurable x)
    (hy : Measurable y) (hz : Measurable z) (ha0 : ∀ p, a p ≠ 0) :
    Measurable (fun p => matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
      (secondCompound (g (a p) (x p) (y p) (z p))))
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun p => matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
      (secondCompound (g (a p) (x p) (y p) (z p)))) =
      (fun p => minorListMinimum (localFieldValuation K) (a p) (x p) (y p) (z p)) :=
    funext fun p => actual_minor_minimum _ _ _ _ _ (ha0 p)
  rw [he]
  unfold minorListMinimum
  have hv := kernel_localFieldValuation_measurable K
  have hzero : Measurable (fun _ : α => (0 : WithTop ℤ)) := measurable_const
  have h0 := (hzero.min (hv.comp ha)).min (hv.comp ha.inv)
  have h1 := (h0.min (hv.comp (ha.mul hx))).min (hv.comp hy)
  have h2 := (h1.min (hv.comp (ha.mul hy))).min (hv.comp (ha.mul hz))
  exact (h2.min (hv.comp (hz.div ha))).min
    (hv.comp (ha.mul ((hy.pow_const 2).sub (hx.mul hz))))

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelEntryIndex_measurable
statement: theorem kernelEntryIndex_measurable : Measurable (kernelEntryIndex K)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Measurable (fun p : KernelPoint K => (p.1 : K)) :=
    (show Measurable (fun a : Kˣ => (a : K)) from MeasurableSpace.le_map_comap).comp
      measurable_fst
  have hm := kernel_entry_minimum_measurable K
    (fun p : KernelPoint K => (p.1 : K)) (fun p => p.2.1)
    (fun p => p.2.2.1) (fun p => p.2.2.2)
    ha measurable_snd.fst measurable_snd.snd.fst measurable_snd.snd.snd
  have he : kernelEntryIndex K = (fun p : KernelPoint K =>
      (matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K) (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)).untopA) := by
    funext p
    exact (WithTop.untopA_eq_untop
      (actual_minima_finite _ _ _ _ _ (Units.ne_zero p.1)).1).symm
  rw [he]
  exact hm.untopA

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelMinorIndex_measurable
statement: theorem kernelMinorIndex_measurable : Measurable (kernelMinorIndex K)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Measurable (fun p : KernelPoint K => (p.1 : K)) :=
    (show Measurable (fun a : Kˣ => (a : K)) from MeasurableSpace.le_map_comap).comp
      measurable_fst
  have hm := kernel_minor_minimum_measurable K
    (fun p : KernelPoint K => (p.1 : K)) (fun p => p.2.1)
    (fun p => p.2.2.1) (fun p => p.2.2.2)
    ha measurable_snd.fst measurable_snd.snd.fst measurable_snd.snd.snd
    (fun p => Units.ne_zero p.1)
  have he : kernelMinorIndex K = (fun p : KernelPoint K =>
      (matrixMinimum (localFieldValuation K)
        (secondCompound (g p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2))).untopA) := by
    funext p
    exact (WithTop.untopA_eq_untop
      (actual_minima_finite _ _ _ _ _ (Units.ne_zero p.1)).2).symm
  rw [he]
  exact hm.untopA

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelN_measurable
statement: theorem kernelN_measurable : Measurable (kernelN K)
proof:
:=
  (kernelEntryIndex_measurable K).sub (kernelMinorIndex_measurable K)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelB_measurable
statement: theorem kernelB_measurable : Measurable (kernelB K)
proof:
:=
  (kernelMinorIndex_measurable K).sub ((kernelEntryIndex_measurable K).const_mul 2)

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelEll_measurable
statement: theorem kernelEll_measurable : Measurable (kernelEll K)
proof:
:=
  (kernelN_measurable K).const_mul 2

name: FourierJacobi.Valuations.kernelHeight_measurable
statement: theorem kernelHeight_measurable : Measurable (kernelHeight K)
proof:
:=
  (kernelN_measurable K).add (kernelB_measurable K)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.valuationRingUnits_smul_integers
statement:
theorem valuationRingUnits_smul_integers (u : Kˣ) (hu : u ∈ valuationRingUnits K) :
    u • (𝒪[K] : Set K) = (𝒪[K] : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h := (𝒪[K]).mul_mem hu.1 hx
    change (u : K) * (((u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) * x) ∈ 𝒪[K] at h
    simpa only [SetLike.mem_coe, ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul] using h
  · intro hx
    exact (𝒪[K]).mul_mem hu.2 hx

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.distribHaarChar_valuationRingUnits
statement:
theorem distribHaarChar_valuationRingUnits (u : Kˣ) (hu : u ∈ valuationRingUnits K) :
    distribHaarChar K u = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := distribHaarChar_mul (additiveHaar K) u (𝒪[K] : Set K)
  rw [valuationRingUnits_smul_integers K u hu, additiveHaar_integers, mul_one] at h
  exact ENNReal.coe_injective h

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.distribHaarChar_eq_of_canonicalValuation
statement:
theorem distribHaarChar_eq_of_canonicalValuation (u : Kˣ) (n : ℤ)
    (hu : localFieldValuation K (u : K) = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    distribHaarChar K u = ((residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  have hs : u ∈ unitValuationShell K n := hu
  rw [unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n] at hs
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_smul_set.mp hs
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_zpow,
    canonicalUniformizer_distribHaarChar K π hπ,
    distribHaarChar_valuationRingUnits K v hv, mul_one]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_smul_of_canonicalValuation
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_smul_of_canonicalValuation (u : Kˣ) (n : ℤ)
    (hu : localFieldValuation K (u : K) = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (s : Set K) :
    additiveHaar K (u • s) =
      (↑(((residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) ^ n) : ℝ≥0∞) * additiveHaar K s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← distribHaarChar_mul, distribHaarChar_eq_of_canonicalValuation K u n hu]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_smul_valuationRingUnits
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_smul_valuationRingUnits (u : Kˣ)
    (hu : u ∈ valuationRingUnits K) (s : Set K) :
    additiveHaar K (u • s) = additiveHaar K s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← distribHaarChar_mul, distribHaarChar_valuationRingUnits K u hu]
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_smul_of_canonicalValuation
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_smul_of_canonicalValuation (u : Kˣ) (n : ℤ)
    (hu : localFieldValuation K (u : K) = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (s : Set K) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (u • s) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-n) * (additiveHaar K).real s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.real, additiveHaar_smul_of_canonicalValuation K u n hu,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_zpow, NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_natCast, inv_zpow, zpow_neg]
  rfl

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_integers
statement: theorem additiveHaar_integers : additiveHaar K (𝒪[K] : Set K) = 1
proof:
:=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaarMeasure_self

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.residueCardinality_pos
statement: theorem residueCardinality_pos : 0 < residueCardinality K
proof: := Nat.card_pos

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.residueCardinality_isPrimePow
statement: theorem residueCardinality_isPrimePow : IsPrimePow (residueCardinality K)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite 𝓀[K]
  simpa [residueCardinality, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (FiniteField.isPrimePow_card (K := 𝓀[K]))

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.residueCardinality_one_lt
statement: theorem residueCardinality_one_lt : 1 < residueCardinality K
proof:
:= by
  have h := (residueCardinality_isPrimePow K).two_le
  omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integers_measurableEmbedding
statement:
theorem integers_measurableEmbedding :
    MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : 𝒪[K] => (x : K))
proof:
:=
  MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe (valuation K).isOpen_integer.measurableSet

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_apply
statement:
theorem integersHaar_apply (s : Set 𝒪[K]) :
    integersHaar K s = additiveHaar K ((fun x : 𝒪[K] => (x : K)) '' s)
proof:
:=
  (integers_measurableEmbedding K).comap_apply (additiveHaar K) s

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_univ
statement: theorem integersHaar_univ : integersHaar K Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integersHaar_apply]
  simpa using additiveHaar_integers K

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.maximalIdeal_ne_bot
statement: theorem maximalIdeal_ne_bot : 𝓂[K] ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field 𝒪[K]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.maximalIdeal_pow_index
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_pow_index (n : ℕ) :
    (𝓂[K] ^ n).toAddSubgroup.index = residueCardinality K ^ n
proof:
:= by
  exact cardQuot_pow_of_prime (maximalIdeal_ne_bot K)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow (n : ℕ) :
    integersHaar K ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) = (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h := (𝓂[K] ^ n).toAddSubgroup.index_mul_measure
    (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal (𝓂[K] ^ n)).measurableSet (integersHaar K)
  rw [maximalIdeal_pow_index, integersHaar_univ, Nat.cast_pow] at h
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_pow, ← one_div]
  exact (ENNReal.eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero n (by exact_mod_cast
    (residueCardinality_pos K).ne')) (by finiteness)).mpr h

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_maximalIdeal_pow (n : ℕ) :
    additiveHaar K ((fun x : 𝒪[K] => (x : K)) '' ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K])) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integersHaar_apply, integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : 𝓂[K] = Ideal.span {π}) (n : ℕ) (x : 𝒪[K]) :
    x ∈ 𝓂[K] ^ n ↔ valuation K (x : K) ≤ valuation K (π : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [hπ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  change x ∈ (Ideal.span {π ^ n} : Set 𝒪[K]) ↔ _
  rw [Valuation.integer.coe_span_singleton_eq_setOfPred_le_v_coe]
  simp

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_uniformizer_pow
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_uniformizer_pow (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : 𝓂[K] = Ideal.span {π}) (n : ℕ) :
    additiveHaar K ((fun u : 𝒪[K] => (π : K) ^ n * (u : K)) '' Set.univ) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun u : 𝒪[K] => (π : K) ^ n * (u : K)) '' Set.univ =
      (fun x : 𝒪[K] => (x : K)) '' ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) := by
    rw [hπ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨π ^ n * u, Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨u, rfl⟩, by simp⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hy
      exact ⟨u, Set.mem_univ _, by simp⟩
  rw [heq, additiveHaar_maximalIdeal_pow]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.mem_integralUnits_iff
statement: theorem mem_integralUnits_iff (x : 𝒪[K]) : x ∈ integralUnits K ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  simp [integralUnits, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integralUnits_measurableSet
statement: theorem integralUnits_measurableSet : MeasurableSet (integralUnits K)
proof:
:=
  (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal 𝓂[K]).measurableSet.compl

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_integralUnits
statement:
theorem integersHaar_integralUnits :
    integersHaar K (integralUnits K) = 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralUnits, measure_compl (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal 𝓂[K]).measurableSet
    (measure_ne_top _ _)]
  simpa using congrArg (fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => 1 - x) (integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow K 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_integralShell
statement:
theorem integersHaar_integralShell (n : ℕ) :
    integersHaar K (integralShell K n) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n -
        (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralShell, measure_sdiff
    (show ((𝓂[K] ^ (n + 1) : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) ⊆ ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) from
      Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n))
    (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal (𝓂[K] ^ (n + 1))).measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet
    (measure_ne_top _ _), integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow, integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.collisionTail_measurableSet
statement: theorem collisionTail_measurableSet (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (collisionTail K n)
proof:
:=
  (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal (𝓂[K] ^ n)).measurableSet.preimage
    (by fun_prop)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.collisionTail_succ_subset
statement:
theorem collisionTail_succ_subset (n : ℕ) :
    collisionTail K (n + 1) ⊆ collisionTail K n
proof:
:=
  Set.preimage_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n))

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.collisionTail_subset_units
statement:
theorem collisionTail_subset_units {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    collisionTail K n ⊆ integralUnits K
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hm : x - 1 ∈ 𝓂[K] :=
    (show 𝓂[K] ^ n ≤ 𝓂[K] from by simpa using
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := 𝓂[K]) hn)) hx
  intro hx'
  have h1 := (𝓂[K]).sub_mem hx' hm
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h1
  exact Ideal.one_notMem 𝓂[K] h1

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_collisionTail
statement:
theorem integersHaar_collisionTail (n : ℕ) :
    integersHaar K (collisionTail K n) = (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [collisionTail, sub_eq_add_neg, measure_preimage_add_right]
  exact integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow K n

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_real_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem integersHaar_real_maximalIdeal_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (integersHaar K).real ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureReal_def, integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_real_integralShell
statement:
theorem integersHaar_real_integralShell (n : ℕ) :
    (integersHaar K).real (integralShell K n) =
      (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) * (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralShell, measureReal_sdiff
    (show ((𝓂[K] ^ (n + 1) : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) ⊆
      ((𝓂[K] ^ n : Ideal 𝒪[K]) : Set 𝒪[K]) from
      Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n))
    (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal (𝓂[K] ^ (n + 1))).measurableSet,
    integersHaar_real_maximalIdeal_pow, integersHaar_real_maximalIdeal_pow, pow_succ]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_real_collisionTail
statement:
theorem integersHaar_real_collisionTail (n : ℕ) :
    (integersHaar K).real (collisionTail K n) = (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureReal_def, integersHaar_collisionTail]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_real_integralUnits
statement:
theorem integersHaar_real_integralUnits :
    (integersHaar K).real (integralUnits K) = 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralUnits, measureReal_compl
    (IsNoetherianRing.isClosed_ideal 𝓂[K]).measurableSet]
  simpa using congrArg (fun x : ℝ => 1 - x) (integersHaar_real_maximalIdeal_pow K 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_of_subset
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_of_subset (s : Set 𝒪[K]) (hs : s ⊆ integralUnits K) :
    unitConditionalMass K s = (integersHaar K).real s /
      (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitConditionalMass, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hs,
    integersHaar_real_integralUnits]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_collisionTail
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_collisionTail (n : ℕ) :
    unitConditionalMass K (collisionTail K (n + 1)) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n / (residueCardinality K - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by
    exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  rw [unitConditionalMass_of_subset _ _ (collisionTail_subset_units K (Nat.succ_pos n)),
    integersHaar_real_collisionTail, pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_collisionDepth
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_collisionDepth (n : ℕ) :
    unitConditionalMass K (collisionTail K (n + 1) \ collisionTail K (n + 2)) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by
    exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  rw [unitConditionalMass_of_subset _ _
    (Set.Subset.trans Set.sdiff_subset (collisionTail_subset_units K (Nat.succ_pos n))),
    measureReal_sdiff (collisionTail_succ_subset K (n + 1))
      (collisionTail_measurableSet K (n + 2)),
    integersHaar_real_collisionTail, integersHaar_real_collisionTail]
  rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
  have hd : 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    have hq0 : (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq).ne'
    have heq : 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ =
        (residueCardinality K - 1) / residueCardinality K := by field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact div_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hq.ne') hq0
  calc
    _ = (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) *
        (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) /
        (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) := by congr 1; ring
    _ = _ := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hd

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_collisionDepth_zero
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_collisionDepth_zero :
    unitConditionalMass K (integralUnits K \ collisionTail K 1) =
      (residueCardinality K - 2) / (residueCardinality K - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by
    exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  rw [unitConditionalMass_of_subset _ _ Set.sdiff_subset,
    measureReal_sdiff (collisionTail_subset_units K (by omega))
      (collisionTail_measurableSet K 1),
    integersHaar_real_collisionTail, integersHaar_real_integralUnits, pow_one]
  field_simp
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitCenteredTail_subset_units
statement:
theorem unitCenteredTail_subset_units (a : 𝒪[K]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    unitCenteredTail K a n ⊆ integralUnits K
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hx'
  have hm : x - (a : 𝒪[K]) ∈ 𝓂[K] :=
    (show 𝓂[K] ^ n ≤ 𝓂[K] from by simpa using
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := 𝓂[K]) hn)) hx
  have ha : (a : 𝒪[K]) ∈ integralUnits K :=
    (mem_integralUnits_iff K _).mpr a.isUnit
  apply ha
  simpa using (𝓂[K]).sub_mem hx' hm

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_unitCenteredTail
statement:
theorem integersHaar_unitCenteredTail (a : 𝒪[K]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    integersHaar K (unitCenteredTail K a n) = (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unitCenteredTail, sub_eq_add_neg, measure_preimage_add_right]
  exact integersHaar_maximalIdeal_pow K n

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_unitCenteredTail
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_unitCenteredTail (a : 𝒪[K]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    unitConditionalMass K (unitCenteredTail K a (n + 1)) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n / (residueCardinality K - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by
    exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  rw [unitConditionalMass_of_subset _ _
    (unitCenteredTail_subset_units K a (Nat.succ_pos n))]
  have hv : (integersHaar K).real (unitCenteredTail K a (n + 1)) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) := by
    simp [measureReal_def, integersHaar_unitCenteredTail]
  rw [hv, pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.valuation_ratio_sub_one
statement:
theorem valuation_ratio_sub_one (a x : 𝒪[K]) (hx : IsUnit x) :
    valuation K ((a : K) / (x : K) - 1) = valuation K ((x : K) - (a : K))
proof:
:= by
  have hvx : valuation K (x : K) = 1 := by
    change valuation K ((algebraMap 𝒪[K] K) x) = 1
    exact (Valuation.integer.integers (valuation K)).isUnit_iff_valuation_eq_one.mp hx
  have hx0 : (x : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hvx
  have heq : (a : K) / (x : K) - 1 = ((a : K) - (x : K)) / (x : K) := by
    field_simp
  rw [heq, map_div₀, hvx, div_one, (valuation K).map_sub_swap]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_ratio_tail
statement:
theorem unitConditionalMass_ratio_tail (π : 𝒪[K]) (hπ : 𝓂[K] = Ideal.span {π})
    (a : 𝒪[K]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    unitConditionalMass K {x : 𝒪[K] | x ∈ integralUnits K ∧
      valuation K (((a : 𝒪[K]) : K) / (x : K) - 1) ≤
        valuation K (π : K) ^ (n + 1)} =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n / (residueCardinality K - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : {x : 𝒪[K] | x ∈ integralUnits K ∧
      valuation K (((a : 𝒪[K]) : K) / (x : K) - 1) ≤
        valuation K (π : K) ^ (n + 1)} = unitCenteredTail K a (n + 1) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hx, hv⟩
      rw [valuation_ratio_sub_one K _ _ ((mem_integralUnits_iff K _).mp hx)] at hv
      exact (mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le K π hπ _ (x - a)).mpr hv
    · intro hx
      have hu := unitCenteredTail_subset_units K a (Nat.succ_pos n) hx
      refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
      rw [valuation_ratio_sub_one K _ _ ((mem_integralUnits_iff K _).mp hu)]
      exact (mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le K π hπ _ (x - a)).mp hx
  rw [heq, unitConditionalMass_unitCenteredTail]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integersHaar_singleton
statement: theorem integersHaar_singleton (x : 𝒪[K]) : integersHaar K {x} = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integersHaar_apply]
  simp

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitConditionalMass_singleton
statement: theorem unitConditionalMass_singleton (x : 𝒪[K]) : unitConditionalMass K {x} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : integersHaar K ({x} ∩ integralUnits K) = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left (integersHaar_singleton K x)
  simp [unitConditionalMass, measureReal_def, h]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionDepth_mem_iff
statement:
theorem shellCollisionDepth_mem_iff (a x : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    x ∈ shellCollisionDepth K a n c ↔
      localFieldValuation K x = (n : WithTop ℤ) ∧
        localFieldValuation K (x - a) = ((n + (c : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shellCollisionDepth, shellCollisionTail, integerShell, integerBall,
    Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  by_cases hx : localFieldValuation K x = (n : WithTop ℤ)
  · simp only [hx, true_and]
    generalize localFieldValuation K (x - a) = v
    induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
    | top => simp only [le_top, not_true_eq_false, and_false, WithTop.top_ne_coe]
    | coe m =>
      simp only [WithTop.coe_inj, WithTop.coe_le_coe]
      omega
  · simp only [hx, false_and, not_false_eq_true, and_true]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.coe_add_eq_coe_add_iff
statement:
theorem coe_add_eq_coe_add_iff (s n : ℤ) (v : WithTop ℤ) :
    (s : WithTop ℤ) + v = ((s + n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔ v = (n : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp only [WithTop.add_top, WithTop.top_ne_coe]
  | coe m => simp only [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_inj, add_right_inj]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.collision_center_valuation
statement:
theorem collision_center_valuation (y z : K) (h j s : ℤ)
    (hy : localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ))
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) (hlocus : 2 * h = j + s) :
    localFieldValuation K (y ^ 2 / z) = (j : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(localFieldValuation K).map_div, (localFieldValuation K).map_pow, hy, hz, two_nsmul]
  change ((h + h - s : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = (j : WithTop ℤ)
  congr 1
  omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.determinant_valuation_at_center
statement:
theorem determinant_valuation_at_center (x y z : K) (s : ℤ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) :
    localFieldValuation K (y ^ 2 - x * z) =
      (s : WithTop ℤ) + localFieldValuation K (x - y ^ 2 / z)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := (localFieldValuation_ne_top K z).mp (by rw [hz]; simp)
  have he : y ^ 2 - x * z = (-z) * (x - y ^ 2 / z) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he, (localFieldValuation K).map_mul, (localFieldValuation K).map_neg, hz]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.jointCollisionDepth_section
statement:
theorem jointCollisionDepth_section (y z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) :
    Prod.mk y ⁻¹' jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c =
      if localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ)
      then shellCollisionDepth K (y ^ 2 / z) j c else ∅
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hy
  · ext x
    simp only [jointCollisionDepth, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hy, true_and,
      shellCollisionDepth_mem_iff, determinant_valuation_at_center K x y z s hz]
    rw [show j + s + (c : ℤ) = s + (j + c) by omega, coe_add_eq_coe_add_iff]
  · ext x
    simp only [jointCollisionDepth, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hy,
      false_and, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.collision_ratio_valuation_iff
statement:
theorem collision_ratio_valuation_iff (x y z : K) (j s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hx : localFieldValuation K x = (j : WithTop ℤ))
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) :
    localFieldValuation K (y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1) = ((c : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      localFieldValuation K (y ^ 2 - x * z) = ((j + s + (c : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := (localFieldValuation_ne_top K x).mp (by rw [hx]; simp)
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := (localFieldValuation_ne_top K z).mp (by rw [hz]; simp)
  have he : y ^ 2 / (x * z) - 1 = (y ^ 2 - x * z) / (x * z) := by
    field_simp
  rw [he, (localFieldValuation K).map_div, (localFieldValuation K).map_mul, hx, hz,
    ← WithTop.coe_add]
  generalize localFieldValuation K (y ^ 2 - x * z) = v
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top =>
    change ((⊤ : WithTop ℤ) = ((c : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)) ↔
      ((⊤ : WithTop ℤ) = ((j + s + (c : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ))
    simp only [WithTop.top_ne_coe]
  | coe d =>
    change ((d - (j + s) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((c : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      (d : WithTop ℤ) = ((j + s + (c : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
    simp only [WithTop.coe_inj]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.sourceJointCollisionDepth_eq_swap
statement:
theorem sourceJointCollisionDepth_eq_swap (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) :
    sourceJointCollisionDepth K z j h c =
      Prod.swap ⁻¹' jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [sourceJointCollisionDepth, jointCollisionDepth, Set.mem_preimage,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.swap]
  by_cases hx : localFieldValuation K p.1 = (j : WithTop ℤ)
  · rw [collision_ratio_valuation_iff K p.1 p.2 z j s c hx hz]
    tauto
  · tauto

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionProbability_nonneg
statement: theorem shellCollisionProbability_nonneg (c : ℕ) : 0 ≤ shellCollisionProbability K c
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (2 : ℝ) ≤ residueCardinality K := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ residueCardinality K by have := residueCardinality_one_lt K; omega)
  unfold shellCollisionProbability
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hq) (by linarith)
  · exact zpow_nonneg (by linarith) _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth
statement:
theorem shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    shellConditionalMass K n (shellCollisionDepth K a n c) = shellCollisionProbability K c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst c
    exact shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_zero K a n ha
  · simpa only [shellCollisionProbability, if_neg hc] using
      shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_pos K a n c ha (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (shellCollisionDepth K a n c) =
      shellCollisionProbability K c * (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K n)
proof:
:= by
  have he := shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth K a n c ha
  rw [shellConditionalMass,
    Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left (shellCollisionDepth_subset K a n c)] at he
  exact (div_eq_iff (additiveHaar_real_integerShell_pos K n).ne').mp he

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_shellCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_shellCollisionDepth (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    additiveHaar K (shellCollisionDepth K a n c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (shellCollisionProbability K c *
        (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth K a n c ha]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top_of_subset
    (shellCollisionDepth_subset K a n c) (additiveHaar_integerShell_ne_top K n))).symm

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet
statement:
theorem jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (integerShell_measurableSet K h).preimage
    (show Measurable (fun p : K × K => p.1) from measurable_fst)
  have h2 := (integerShell_measurableSet K j).preimage
    (show Measurable (fun p : K × K => p.2) from measurable_snd)
  have h3 := (integerShell_measurableSet K (j + s + (c : ℤ))).preimage
    (show Measurable (fun p : K × K => p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 * z) by fun_prop)
  exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_prod_jointCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_prod_jointCollisionDepth (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) (hlocus : 2 * h = j + s) :
    ((additiveHaar K).prod (additiveHaar K)) (jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (shellCollisionProbability K c *
        (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K j)) * additiveHaar K (integerShell K h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.prod_apply (jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet K z j h s c)]
  have he : (fun y => additiveHaar K (Prod.mk y ⁻¹' jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c)) =
      (integerShell K h).indicator (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal (shellCollisionProbability K c *
        (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K j))) := by
    funext y
    rw [jointCollisionDepth_section K y z j h s c hz]
    by_cases hy : localFieldValuation K y = (h : WithTop ℤ)
    · rw [if_pos hy, Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ integerShell K h from hy),
        additiveHaar_shellCollisionDepth K (y ^ 2 / z) j c
          (collision_center_valuation K y z h j s hy hz hlocus)]
    · rw [if_neg hy, Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ integerShell K h from hy), measure_empty]
  rw [he, lintegral_indicator_const (integerShell_measurableSet K h)]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_prod_jointCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_prod_jointCollisionDepth (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) (hlocus : 2 * h = j + s) :
    ((additiveHaar K).prod (additiveHaar K)).real (jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c) =
      shellCollisionProbability K c *
        ((1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
          ((residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-j) * (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-h)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.real, additiveHaar_prod_jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c hz hlocus,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (mul_nonneg (shellCollisionProbability_nonneg K c) measureReal_nonneg)]
  change shellCollisionProbability K c * (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K j) *
    (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K h) = _
  rw [additiveHaar_real_integerShell, additiveHaar_real_integerShell]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.sourceJointCollisionDepth_measurableSet
statement:
theorem sourceJointCollisionDepth_measurableSet (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) :
    MeasurableSet (sourceJointCollisionDepth K z j h c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceJointCollisionDepth_eq_swap K z j h s c hz]
  exact (jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet K z j h s c).preimage measurable_swap

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_prod_sourceJointCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_prod_sourceJointCollisionDepth (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) (hlocus : 2 * h = j + s) :
    ((additiveHaar K).prod (additiveHaar K)) (sourceJointCollisionDepth K z j h c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (shellCollisionProbability K c *
        (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K j)) * additiveHaar K (integerShell K h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceJointCollisionDepth_eq_swap K z j h s c hz,
    ← Measure.map_apply measurable_swap (jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet K z j h s c),
    Measure.prod_swap]
  exact additiveHaar_prod_jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c hz hlocus

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_prod_sourceJointCollisionDepth
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_prod_sourceJointCollisionDepth (z : K) (j h s : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (hz : localFieldValuation K z = (s : WithTop ℤ)) (hlocus : 2 * h = j + s) :
    ((additiveHaar K).prod (additiveHaar K)).real (sourceJointCollisionDepth K z j h c) =
      (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        ((residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-j) * (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-h)) *
          shellCollisionProbability K c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.real, sourceJointCollisionDepth_eq_swap K z j h s c hz,
    ← Measure.map_apply measurable_swap (jointCollisionDepth_measurableSet K z j h s c),
    Measure.prod_swap]
  change ((additiveHaar K).prod (additiveHaar K)).real (jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c) = _
  rw [additiveHaar_real_prod_jointCollisionDepth K z j h s c hz hlocus]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.localField_punctured_nhds
statement: theorem localField_punctured_nhds : (𝓝[≠] (0 : K)).NeBot
proof:
:= by
  rw [nhdsWithin_neBot]
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγs⟩ := (IsValuativeTopology.hasBasis_nhds_zero' K).mem_iff.mp hs
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ValuativeRel.valuation_surjective γ
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hγ
    rw [← hb, h, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩ := Valuation.IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one (v := ValuativeRel.valuation K)
  refine ⟨b * a, hγs ?_, by simpa using mul_ne_zero hb0 ha0⟩
  change ValuativeRel.valuation K (b * a) < γ
  rw [map_mul, hb]
  simpa using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ha (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.measurableSet_determinant_zero
statement:
theorem measurableSet_determinant_zero (z : K) :
    MeasurableSet {p : K × K | p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z = 0}
proof:
:= by
  exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const).measurableSet

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.determinant_zero_section
statement:
theorem determinant_zero_section (y z : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    {x : K | y ^ 2 - x * z = 0} = {y ^ 2 / z}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_singleton_iff, sub_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨fun h => (eq_div_iff hz).mpr h.symm, fun h => ((eq_div_iff hz).mp h).symm⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.determinant_zero_null
statement:
theorem determinant_zero_null (z : K) :
    (μ.prod ν) {p : K × K | p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_prod_null_of_ae_null (measurableSet_determinant_zero z)
  filter_upwards [] with x
  change ν {y : K | y ^ 2 - x * z = 0} = 0
  have hfinite : Set.Finite {y : K | y ^ 2 - x * z = 0} := by
    have hpoly : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (x * z) : Polynomial K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hc := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial K => p.coeff 2) h
      norm_num at hc
    convert Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hpoly using 1
    ext y
    simp [Polynomial.IsRoot]
  exact hfinite.measure_zero ν

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.coordinates_determinant_ae
statement:
theorem coordinates_determinant_ae (z : K) :
    ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod ν, p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (μ.prod ν) {p : K × K | p.1 = 0} = 0 := by
    have he : {p : K × K | p.1 = 0} = ({0} : Set K) ×ˢ univ := by ext; simp
    rw [he]
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    exact (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  have hy : (μ.prod ν) {p : K × K | p.2 = 0} = 0 := by
    have he : {p : K × K | p.2 = 0} = univ ×ˢ ({0} : Set K) := by ext; simp
    rw [he]
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    exact (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  have hd := determinant_zero_null μ ν z
  have hx' : ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod ν, p.1 ≠ 0 := by simpa [ae_iff] using hx
  have hy' : ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod ν, p.2 ≠ 0 := by simpa [ae_iff] using hy
  have hd' : ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod ν, p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z ≠ 0 := by simpa [ae_iff] using hd
  filter_upwards [hx', hy', hd'] with p hp hq hd
  exact ⟨hp, hq, hd⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.restrict_goodCoordinates
statement:
theorem restrict_goodCoordinates (z : K) :
    (μ.prod ν).restrict {p : K × K |
      p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z ≠ 0} = μ.prod ν
proof:
:=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem (coordinates_determinant_ae μ ν z)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.coordinates_determinant_ae_with_parameter
statement:
theorem coordinates_determinant_ae_with_parameter {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    (ρ : MeasureTheory.Measure A) (z : K) :
    ∀ᵐ p : A × (K × K) ∂ρ.prod (μ.prod ν),
      p.2.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2.2 ^ 2 - p.2.1 * z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := coordinates_determinant_ae μ ν z
  rw [ae_iff] at h ⊢
  have he : {p : A × (K × K) |
    ¬ (p.2.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2.2 ^ 2 - p.2.1 * z ≠ 0)} =
    univ ×ˢ {p : K × K |
    ¬ (p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z ≠ 0)} := by ext; simp
  rw [he]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  exact (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod_le _ _).trans_eq (by rw [h, mul_zero]; rfl)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.localField_haar_nullSingletonClass
statement: theorem localField_haar_nullSingletonClass : NullSingletonClass μ
proof:
:= by
  let := IsTopologicalAddGroup.rightUniformSpace K
  let := isUniformAddGroup_of_addCommGroup (G := K)
  let : (𝓝[≠] (0 : K)).NeBot := localField_punctured_nhds K
  infer_instance

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.localField_coordinates_determinant_ae
statement:
theorem localField_coordinates_determinant_ae (z : K) :
    ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod μ,
      p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let := IsTopologicalAddGroup.rightUniformSpace K
  let := isUniformAddGroup_of_addCommGroup (G := K)
  let : (Valued.v (R := K) (Γ₀ := ValuativeRel.ValueGroupWithZero K)).RankOne :=
    { hom' := ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.nonempty.some.emb (R := K) |>.comp
        MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.embedding
      strictMono' := ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.nonempty.some.strictMono.comp
        MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.embedding_strictMono }
  let : NontriviallyNormedField K := Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField
    (L := K) (Γ₀ := ValuativeRel.ValueGroupWithZero K)
  let : ProperSpace K := .of_nontriviallyNormedField_of_weaklyLocallyCompactSpace K
  let : NullSingletonClass μ := localField_haar_nullSingletonClass K μ
  exact coordinates_determinant_ae μ μ z

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.localField_finite_valuations_ae
statement:
theorem localField_finite_valuations_ae (z : K) :
    ∀ᵐ p : K × K ∂μ.prod μ, ∃ j h c : ℤ,
      Valuations.localFieldValuation K p.1 = (j : WithTop ℤ) ∧
      Valuations.localFieldValuation K p.2 = (h : WithTop ℤ) ∧
      Valuations.localFieldValuation K (p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * z) = (c : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [localField_coordinates_determinant_ae K μ z] with p hp
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp
    ((Valuations.localFieldValuation_ne_top K p.1).mpr hp.1)
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp
    ((Valuations.localFieldValuation_ne_top K p.2).mpr hp.2.1)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp
    ((Valuations.localFieldValuation_ne_top K _).mpr hp.2.2)
  exact ⟨j, h, c, hj.symm, hh.symm, hc.symm⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionTail_zero_eq
statement:
theorem shellCollisionTail_zero_eq (a : K) (n : ℤ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    shellCollisionTail K a n 0 = integerShell K n
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left
  intro x hx
  change (n + (0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ localFieldValuation K (x - a)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  exact (localFieldValuation K).map_le_sub (le_of_eq hx.symm) (le_of_eq ha.symm)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionTail_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem shellCollisionTail_eq_preimage (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (hc : 0 < c) :
    shellCollisionTail K a n c =
      (fun x : K => x - a) ⁻¹' integerBall K (n + c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right
  intro x hx
  change localFieldValuation K x = (n : WithTop ℤ)
  have hlt : localFieldValuation K a < localFieldValuation K (x - a) := by
    rw [ha]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast (show n < n + (c : ℤ) by omega)) hx
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel, ha] using
    (localFieldValuation K).map_add_eq_of_lt_right hlt

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionTail_succ_subset
statement:
theorem shellCollisionTail_succ_subset (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    shellCollisionTail K a n (c + 1) ⊆ shellCollisionTail K a n c
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
  change ((n + (c : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ localFieldValuation K (x - a)
  have hx' : ((n + ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
      localFieldValuation K (x - a) := hx.2
  apply le_trans ?_ hx'
  exact_mod_cast (show n + (c : ℤ) ≤ n + ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionDepth_subset
statement:
theorem shellCollisionDepth_subset (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    shellCollisionDepth K a n c ⊆ integerShell K n
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.trans Set.sdiff_subset Set.inter_subset_left

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionDepth_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem shellCollisionDepth_eq_preimage (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (hc : 0 < c) :
    shellCollisionDepth K a n c =
      (fun x : K => x - a) ⁻¹' integerShell K (n + c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shellCollisionDepth, shellCollisionTail_eq_preimage K a n c ha hc,
    shellCollisionTail_eq_preimage K a n (c + 1) ha (Nat.succ_pos c),
    ← Set.preimage_sdiff, integerShell_eq_sdiff]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionTail_measurableSet
statement:
theorem shellCollisionTail_measurableSet (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (shellCollisionTail K a n c)
proof:
:=
  (integerShell_measurableSet K n).inter
    ((integerBall_measurableSet K (n + c)).preimage (by fun_prop))

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellCollisionDepth_measurableSet
statement:
theorem shellCollisionDepth_measurableSet (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (shellCollisionDepth K a n c)
proof:
:=
  (shellCollisionTail_measurableSet K a n c).diff
    (shellCollisionTail_measurableSet K a n (c + 1))

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionTail
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionTail (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (shellCollisionTail K a n c) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-(n + (c : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shellCollisionTail_eq_preimage K a n c ha hc]
  simpa only [Measure.real, sub_eq_add_neg, measure_preimage_add_right] using
    additiveHaar_real_integerBall K (n + c)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth_pos
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth_pos (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (shellCollisionDepth K a n c) =
      (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-(n + (c : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shellCollisionDepth_eq_preimage K a n c ha hc]
  simpa only [Measure.real, sub_eq_add_neg, measure_preimage_add_right] using
    additiveHaar_real_integerShell K (n + c)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellConditionalMass_of_subset
statement:
theorem shellConditionalMass_of_subset (n : ℤ) (s : Set K)
    (hs : s ⊆ integerShell K n) :
    shellConditionalMass K n s =
      (additiveHaar K).real s /
        ((1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) * (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shellConditionalMass, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hs, additiveHaar_real_integerShell]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_pos
statement:
theorem shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_pos (a : K) (n : ℤ) (c : ℕ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) (hc : 0 < c) :
    shellConditionalMass K n (shellCollisionDepth K a n c) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-(c : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := lt_trans zero_lt_one hq
  have hs : 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr ((inv_lt_one₀ hq0).mpr hq)).ne'
  rw [shellConditionalMass_of_subset K n _ (shellCollisionDepth_subset K a n c),
    additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionDepth_pos K a n c ha hc,
    neg_add, zpow_add₀ hq0.ne']
  field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr hq.ne']

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_zero
statement:
theorem shellConditionalMass_collisionDepth_zero (a : K) (n : ℤ)
    (ha : localFieldValuation K a = (n : WithTop ℤ)) :
    shellConditionalMass K n (shellCollisionDepth K a n 0) =
      (residueCardinality K - 2) / (residueCardinality K - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := lt_trans zero_lt_one hq
  have hs : 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr ((inv_lt_one₀ hq0).mpr hq)).ne'
  rw [shellConditionalMass_of_subset K n _ (shellCollisionDepth_subset K a n 0),
    shellCollisionDepth,
    measureReal_sdiff (shellCollisionTail_succ_subset K a n 0)
      (shellCollisionTail_measurableSet K a n 1)
      (measure_ne_top_of_subset Set.inter_subset_left (additiveHaar_integerShell_ne_top K n)),
    shellCollisionTail_zero_eq K a n ha, additiveHaar_real_integerShell,
    additiveHaar_real_shellCollisionTail K a n 1 ha (by decide)]
  rw [Nat.cast_one, show -(n + 1) = -n + -1 by omega, zpow_add₀ hq0.ne', zpow_neg_one]
  field_simp
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.shellConditionalMass_singleton
statement:
theorem shellConditionalMass_singleton (a : K) (n : ℤ) :
    shellConditionalMass K n {a} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : additiveHaar K ({a} ∩ integerShell K n) = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left (measure_singleton a)
  simp only [shellConditionalMass, Measure.real, h, ENNReal.toReal_zero, zero_div]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.paperMultiplicativeFactor_pos
statement: theorem paperMultiplicativeFactor_pos : 0 < 1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  exact sub_pos.mpr ((inv_lt_one₀ (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq)).mpr hq)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.paperMultiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits
statement:
theorem paperMultiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits :
    paperMultiplicativeHaar K (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [paperMultiplicativeHaar, Measure.smul_apply,
    multiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.paperMultiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell
statement:
theorem paperMultiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell (n : ℤ) :
    paperMultiplicativeHaar K (unitValuationShell K n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [paperMultiplicativeHaar, Measure.smul_apply,
    multiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.paperMultiplicativeHaar_real_unitValuationShell
statement:
theorem paperMultiplicativeHaar_real_unitValuationShell (n : ℤ) :
    (paperMultiplicativeHaar K).real (unitValuationShell K n) =
      1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.real, paperMultiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (paperMultiplicativeFactor_pos K).le]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.valuationRingUnits_isCompact
statement: theorem valuationRingUnits_isCompact : IsCompact (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ)
proof:
:=
  Submonoid.units_isCompact (S := (𝒪[K]).toSubmonoid)
    (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.isCompact_closedBall K 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.valuationRingUnits_isOpen
statement: theorem valuationRingUnits_isOpen : IsOpen (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ)
proof:
:=
  Submonoid.isOpen_units (U := (𝒪[K]).toSubmonoid) (valuation K).isOpen_integer

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_zero_eq
statement:
theorem unitValuationShell_zero_eq :
    unitValuationShell K 0 = (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero K (u : K)).mpr u.ne_zero
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero K (↑(u⁻¹) : K)).mpr (u⁻¹).ne_zero
  have hadd : (m : WithTop ℤ) + (n : WithTop ℤ) = 0 := by
    rw [← hm, ← hn, ← (localFieldValuation K).map_mul]
    rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, (localFieldValuation K).map_one]
  have hmn : m + n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hadd
  change localFieldValuation K (u : K) = (0 : WithTop ℤ) ↔
    (u : K) ∈ 𝒪[K] ∧ (↑(u⁻¹) : K) ∈ 𝒪[K]
  rw [← localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff, ← localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff, hm, hn]
  change (m : WithTop ℤ) = ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ↔
    ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (m : WithTop ℤ) ∧
    ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (n : WithTop ℤ)
  simp only [WithTop.coe_inj, WithTop.coe_le_coe]
  omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul
statement:
theorem unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    unitValuationShell K n =
      (canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ n) • (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, ← unitValuationShell_zero_eq, ← zpow_neg]
  change localFieldValuation K (u : K) = (n : WithTop ℤ) ↔
    localFieldValuation K ((canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ (-n)) • (u : K)) = 0
  rw [canonicalValuation_uniformizer_smul]
  generalize localFieldValuation K (u : K) = v
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe m =>
    rw [← WithTop.coe_add]
    change (m : WithTop ℤ) = (n : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      ((-n + m : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
    simp only [WithTop.coe_inj]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_isOpen
statement: theorem unitValuationShell_isOpen (n : ℤ) : IsOpen (unitValuationShell K n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  rw [unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n]
  exact (valuationRingUnits_isOpen K).smul _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_isCompact
statement: theorem unitValuationShell_isCompact (n : ℤ) : IsCompact (unitValuationShell K n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  rw [unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n]
  exact (valuationRingUnits_isCompact K).smul _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem unitValuationShell_pairwiseDisjoint :
    Pairwise (fun m n : ℤ => Disjoint (unitValuationShell K m) (unitValuationShell K n))
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro u hm hn
  exact hmn (integerShell_unique K (u : K) m n hm hn)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.existsUnique_unitValuationShell
statement:
theorem existsUnique_unitValuationShell (u : Kˣ) :
    ∃! n : ℤ, u ∈ unitValuationShell K n
proof:
:=
  existsUnique_integerShell K (u : K) u.ne_zero

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.iUnion_unitValuationShell_eq
statement: theorem iUnion_unitValuationShell_eq : (⋃ n : ℤ, unitValuationShell K n) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro u
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr (existsUnique_unitValuationShell K u).exists

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.unitValuationShell_measurableSet
statement: theorem unitValuationShell_measurableSet (n : ℤ) : MeasurableSet (unitValuationShell K n)
proof:
:=
  (unitValuationShell_isOpen K n).measurableSet

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.multiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits
statement:
theorem multiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits :
    multiplicativeHaar K (valuationRingUnits K : Set Kˣ) = 1
proof:
:=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure_self

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.multiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell
statement:
theorem multiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell (n : ℤ) :
    multiplicativeHaar K (unitValuationShell K n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  rw [unitValuationShell_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n, measure_smul,
    multiplicativeHaar_valuationRingUnits]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.multiplicativeHaar_real_unitValuationShell
statement:
theorem multiplicativeHaar_real_unitValuationShell (n : ℤ) :
    (multiplicativeHaar K).real (unitValuationShell K n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Measure.real, multiplicativeHaar_unitValuationShell, ENNReal.toReal_one]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.extendedNegLog_eq_coe_iff
statement:
theorem extendedNegLog_eq_coe_iff (z : ℤᵐ⁰) (n : ℤ) :
    extendedNegLog z = (n : WithTop ℤ) ↔ z = WithZero.exp (-n)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using WithZero.expRecOn with
  | zero =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact False.elim (WithTop.top_ne_coe h)
    · intro h
      exact False.elim (WithZero.exp_ne_zero h.symm)
  | exp a =>
    simp only [extendedNegLog_exp, WithTop.coe_inj, WithZero.exp_inj]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.intValue_lt_one_iff_le_exp_neg_one
statement:
theorem intValue_lt_one_iff_le_exp_neg_one (z : ℤᵐ⁰) :
    z < 1 ↔ z ≤ WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using WithZero.expRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | exp a =>
    change WithZero.exp a < WithZero.exp (0 : ℤ) ↔
      WithZero.exp a ≤ WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)
    rw [WithZero.exp_lt_exp, WithZero.exp_le_exp]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonicalValuation_eq_coe_iff
statement:
theorem canonicalValuation_eq_coe_iff (x : K) (n : ℤ) :
    localFieldValuation K x = (n : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      discreteValuation K x = WithZero.exp (-n)
proof:
:=
  extendedNegLog_eq_coe_iff (discreteValuation K x) n

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer
statement:
theorem exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer :
    ∃ π : 𝒪[K], localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := localFieldValuation_surjective K (1 : WithTop ℤ)
  have hint : x ∈ 𝒪[K] := (localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff K x).mp (by rw [hx]; norm_num)
  exact ⟨⟨x, hint⟩, hx⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonical_uniformizer_ne_zero
statement:
theorem canonical_uniformizer_ne_zero (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) : (π : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  rw [he, localFieldValuation_zero] at hπ
  exact WithTop.top_ne_coe hπ

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonical_uniformizer_generates
statement:
theorem canonical_uniformizer_generates (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) : 𝓂[K] = Ideal.span {π}
proof:
:= by
  have hdπ : discreteValuation K (π : K) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) :=
    (canonicalValuation_eq_coe_iff K (π : K) 1).mp hπ
  ext x
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
    Valuation.Integer.not_isUnit_iff_valuation_lt_one]
  change valuation K (x : K) < 1 ↔ x ∈ (Ideal.span {π} : Set 𝒪[K])
  rw [Valuation.integer.coe_span_singleton_eq_setOfPred_le_v_coe]
  change valuation K (x : K) < 1 ↔ valuation K (x : K) ≤ valuation K (π : K)
  have hlt : valuation K (x : K) < 1 ↔ discreteValuation K (x : K) < 1 := by
    change valuation K (x : K) < 1 ↔
      IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K (valuation K (x : K)) < 1
    rw [← map_one (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K)]
    exact (map_lt_map_iff (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K)).symm
  have hle : valuation K (x : K) ≤ valuation K (π : K) ↔
      discreteValuation K (x : K) ≤ discreteValuation K (π : K) :=
    (map_le_map_iff (IsNonarchimedeanLocalField.valueGroupWithZeroIsoInt K)).symm
  rw [hlt, hle, hdπ]
  exact intValue_lt_one_iff_le_exp_neg_one _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonical_uniformizer_zpow
statement:
theorem canonical_uniformizer_zpow (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    localFieldValuation K ((π : K) ^ n) = (n : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalValuation_eq_coe_iff, map_zpow₀,
    (canonicalValuation_eq_coe_iff K (π : K) 1).mp hπ, ← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
  congr 1
  simp

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerShell_eq_sdiff
statement:
theorem integerShell_eq_sdiff (n : ℤ) :
    integerShell K n = integerBall K n \ integerBall K (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [integerShell, integerBall, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_sdiff]
  generalize localFieldValuation K x = v
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe m =>
    simp only [WithTop.coe_inj, WithTop.coe_le_coe]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerBall_succ_subset
statement: theorem integerBall_succ_subset (n : ℤ) : integerBall K (n + 1) ⊆ integerBall K n
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change ((n + 1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ localFieldValuation K x at hx
  change (n : WithTop ℤ) ≤ localFieldValuation K x
  exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ n + 1 by omega)) hx

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerShell_unique
statement:
theorem integerShell_unique (x : K) (m n : ℤ)
    (hm : x ∈ integerShell K m) (hn : x ∈ integerShell K n) : m = n
proof:
:=
  WithTop.coe_injective (hm.symm.trans hn)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero (x : K) :
    (∃ n : ℤ, x ∈ integerShell K n) ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite (v : WithTop ℤ) : (∃ n : ℤ, v = (n : WithTop ℤ)) ↔ v ≠ ⊤ := by
    induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
    | top => simp
    | coe m => simp
  exact (hfinite (localFieldValuation K x)).trans (localFieldValuation_ne_top K x)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.existsUnique_integerShell
statement:
theorem existsUnique_integerShell (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃! n : ℤ, x ∈ integerShell K n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero K x).mpr hx
  exact ⟨n, hn, fun m hm => integerShell_unique K x m n hm hn⟩

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerShell_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem integerShell_pairwiseDisjoint :
    Pairwise (fun m n : ℤ => Disjoint (integerShell K m) (integerShell K n))
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hm hn
