  exact hmn (integerShell_unique K x m n hm hn)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.iUnion_integerShell_eq
statement: theorem iUnion_integerShell_eq : (⋃ n : ℤ, integerShell K n) = ({0} : Set K)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    exists_integerShell_iff_ne_zero K x

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonicalValuation_uniformizer_smul
statement:
theorem canonicalValuation_uniformizer_smul (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) (n : ℤ) (x : K) :
    localFieldValuation K ((canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ n) • x) =
      (n : WithTop ℤ) + localFieldValuation K x
proof:
:= by
  change localFieldValuation K (((canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ n : Kˣ) : K) * x) = _
  rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]
  change localFieldValuation K ((π : K) ^ n * x) = _
  rw [(localFieldValuation K).map_mul, canonical_uniformizer_zpow K π hπ n]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.coe_le_iff_neg_add_nonnegative
statement:
theorem coe_le_iff_neg_add_nonnegative (n : ℤ) (v : WithTop ℤ) :
    (n : WithTop ℤ) ≤ v ↔ 0 ≤ ((-n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe m =>
    rw [← WithTop.coe_add]
    change (n : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (m : WithTop ℤ) ↔
      ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ ((-n + m : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
    simp only [WithTop.coe_le_coe]
    omega

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerBall_eq_uniformizer_smul
statement:
theorem integerBall_eq_uniformizer_smul (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    integerBall K n = (canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ n) • (𝒪[K] : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  change (n : WithTop ℤ) ≤ localFieldValuation K x ↔
    (canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ ^ n)⁻¹ • x ∈ (valuation K).integer
  rw [← localFieldValuation_nonnegative_iff, ← zpow_neg,
    canonicalValuation_uniformizer_smul]
  exact coe_le_iff_neg_add_nonnegative n _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerBall_isOpen
statement: theorem integerBall_isOpen (n : ℤ) : IsOpen (integerBall K n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  rw [integerBall_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n]
  exact (valuation K).isOpen_integer.smul _

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerBall_measurableSet
statement: theorem integerBall_measurableSet (n : ℤ) : MeasurableSet (integerBall K n)
proof:
:=
  (integerBall_isOpen K n).measurableSet

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.integerShell_measurableSet
statement: theorem integerShell_measurableSet (n : ℤ) : MeasurableSet (integerShell K n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integerShell_eq_sdiff]
  exact (integerBall_measurableSet K n).diff (integerBall_measurableSet K (n + 1))

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonicalUniformizer_distribHaarChar
statement:
theorem canonicalUniformizer_distribHaarChar (π : 𝒪[K])
    (hπ : localFieldValuation K (π : K) = 1) :
    distribHaarChar K (canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ) =
      (residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have heq : canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ • (𝒪[K] : Set K) =
      (fun u : 𝒪[K] => (π : K) ^ 1 * (u : K)) '' Set.univ := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hax⟩
      refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      simpa only [canonicalUniformizerUnit, Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, pow_one, smul_eq_mul] using hax
    · rintro ⟨a, _, hax⟩
      refine ⟨(a : K), a.property, ?_⟩
      simpa only [canonicalUniformizerUnit, Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0, pow_one, smul_eq_mul] using hax
  have hm := additiveHaar_uniformizer_pow K π (canonical_uniformizer_generates K π hπ) 1
  have hc := distribHaarChar_mul (additiveHaar K) (canonicalUniformizerUnit K π hπ)
    (𝒪[K] : Set K)
  rw [additiveHaar_integers, mul_one, heq, hm, pow_one] at hc
  apply ENNReal.coe_injective
  rw [ENNReal.coe_inv (by exact_mod_cast (residueCardinality_pos K).ne')]
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hc

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_integerBall
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_integerBall (n : ℤ) :
    additiveHaar K (integerBall K n) =
      (((residueCardinality K : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) ^ n : ℝ≥0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := exists_integral_canonical_uniformizer K
  rw [integerBall_eq_uniformizer_smul K π hπ n, ← distribHaarChar_mul,
    additiveHaar_integers, mul_one, map_zpow, canonicalUniformizer_distribHaarChar K π hπ]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_integerBall_ne_top
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_integerBall_ne_top (n : ℤ) :
    additiveHaar K (integerBall K n) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [additiveHaar_integerBall]
  exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_integerBall
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_integerBall (n : ℤ) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (integerBall K n) = (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureReal_def, additiveHaar_integerBall, zpow_neg]

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_integerShell
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_integerShell (n : ℤ) :
    (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K n) =
      (1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) * (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integerShell_eq_sdiff, measureReal_sdiff (integerBall_succ_subset K n)
    (integerBall_measurableSet K (n + 1)) (additiveHaar_integerBall_ne_top K n),
    additiveHaar_real_integerBall, additiveHaar_real_integerBall]
  have hq : (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (residueCardinality_pos K).ne'
  rw [show -(n + 1) = -n + -1 by omega, zpow_add₀ hq, zpow_neg_one]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_real_integerShell_pos
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_real_integerShell_pos (n : ℤ) :
    0 < (additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K n)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := by exact_mod_cast residueCardinality_one_lt K
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < residueCardinality K := lt_trans zero_lt_one hq
  rw [additiveHaar_real_integerShell]
  exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr ((inv_lt_one₀ hq0).mpr hq)) (zpow_pos hq0 _)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_integerShell_ne_top
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_integerShell_ne_top (n : ℤ) :
    additiveHaar K (integerShell K n) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [integerShell_eq_sdiff]
  exact measure_ne_top_of_subset Set.sdiff_subset (additiveHaar_integerBall_ne_top K n)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.additiveHaar_integerShell
statement:
theorem additiveHaar_integerShell (n : ℤ) :
    additiveHaar K (integerShell K n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - (residueCardinality K : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        (residueCardinality K : ℝ) ^ (-n))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((additiveHaar K).real (integerShell K n)) :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (additiveHaar_integerShell_ne_top K n)).symm
    _ = _ := congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (additiveHaar_real_integerShell K n)

name: FourierJacobi.Measure.canonicalValuation_measurable
statement:
theorem canonicalValuation_measurable [MeasurableSpace (WithTop ℤ)] :
    Measurable (localFieldValuation K)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro v
  induction v using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top =>
    have heq : (localFieldValuation K) ⁻¹' {⊤} = {0} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact not_iff_not.mp (localFieldValuation_ne_top K x)
    rw [heq]
    exact measurableSet_singleton 0
  | coe n =>
    exact integerShell_measurableSet K n

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_weights_cleared
statement:
theorem weyl_weights_cleared (t a b : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (i : Fin 8) :
    weylWall a b * weylWeights t a b i = weylWeightNumerators t a b i
proof:
:= by
  have ha₁' : 1 - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (sub_ne_zero.mp ha₁))
  have hb₁' : 1 - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (sub_ne_zero.mp hb₁))
  have hab' : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (sub_ne_zero.mp hab))
  have hab₁' : 1 - a * b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (sub_ne_zero.mp hab₁))
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [weylWall, weylWeights, weylWeightNumerators, rootFactor] <;>
    field_simp <;> ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_height_cleared
statement:
theorem weyl_height_cleared (t a b d : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (i : Fin 8) :
    (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * weylScale a b i) *
      kernelNumerator t d (weylU a b i) (weylV a b i) =
      weylHeightNumerators t a b d i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [weylScale, weylU, weylV, kernelNumerator, weylHeightNumerators,
      weylHeight0, weylHeight1, weylHeight2, weylHeight3,
      weylHeight4, weylHeight5, weylHeight6, weylHeight7] <;>
    field_simp <;> ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_denominator_factorization
statement:
theorem weyl_denominator_factorization (t a b d : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (i : Fin 8) :
    weylCommonDenominator t a b d =
      weylWall a b * weylKernelDenominator t a b d i *
        (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * weylScale a b i) * weylRemainingFactors t a b d i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [weylCommonDenominator, weylKernelDenominator, weylV,
      weylScale, weylRemainingFactors] <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.clear_weighted_kernel
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (R * A) * (S * H) * B := by field_simp
    _ = _ := by rw [hA, hH]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_term_cleared
statement:
theorem weyl_term_cleared (t a b d : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0) (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 8) (hD : weylKernelDenominator t a b d i ≠ 0) :
    weylCommonDenominator t a b d * weylTerms t a b d i =
      weylClearedTerms t a b d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [weyl_denominator_factorization t a b d ha hb hd i]
  exact clear_weighted_kernel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hD
    (weyl_weights_cleared t a b ha hb ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁ i)
    (weyl_height_cleared t a b d ha hb i)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.eight_weyl_sum
statement:
theorem eight_weyl_sum (t a b d : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0) (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ i, weylKernelDenominator t a b d i ≠ 0)
    (hW : weylCommonDenominator t a b d ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 8, weylTerms t a b d i) =
      weylTargetNumerator t a b d / weylCommonDenominator t a b d
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff hW).mpr
  rw [mul_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp_rw [weyl_term_cleared t a b d ha hb hd ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁ _ (hD _)]
  exact weyl_polynomial_identity t a b d

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.tensor_denominator_cleared
statement:
theorem tensor_denominator_cleared (t a b d : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d ^ 4) * (d₁ t a b d * d₂ t a b d) =
      tensorDenominatorPolynomial t a b d
proof:
:= by
  unfold d₁ d₂ fourFactors tensorDenominatorPolynomial
  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_common_euler_factorization
statement:
theorem weyl_common_euler_factorization (t a b d : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    weylCommonDenominator t a b d =
      (weylWall a b * a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d * (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d ^ 4)) *
        (d₁ t a b d * d₂ t a b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (weylWall a b * a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d) *
        tensorDenominatorPolynomial t a b d := by
      unfold weylCommonDenominator tensorDenominatorPolynomial
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← tensor_denominator_cleared t a b d ha hb hd]; ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_target_numerator_eq
statement:
theorem weyl_target_numerator_eq (t a b d : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    weylTargetNumerator t a b d =
      (weylWall a b * a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d * (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 * d ^ 4)) *
        (satakeNumerator a b * (1 - t ^ 2) * n₁ t a b * n₂ t a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weylTargetNumerator weylWall satakeNumerator n₁ n₂ fourFactors
  field_simp
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_target_cleared
statement:
theorem weyl_target_cleared (t a b d : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hD : d₁ t a b d * d₂ t a b d ≠ 0) :
    weylCommonDenominator t a b d * weylClosedExpression t a b d =
      weylTargetNumerator t a b d
proof:
:= by
  rw [weyl_common_euler_factorization t a b d ha hb hd, weyl_target_numerator_eq t a b d ha hb]
  unfold weylClosedExpression
  generalize (d₁ t a b d * d₂ t a b d) = D at *
  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.eight_weyl_sum_closed
statement:
theorem eight_weyl_sum_closed (t a b d : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0) (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ i, weylKernelDenominator t a b d i ≠ 0)
    (hW : weylCommonDenominator t a b d ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 8, weylTerms t a b d i) = weylClosedExpression t a b d
proof:
:= by
  have he := hW
  rw [weyl_common_euler_factorization t a b d ha hb hd] at he
  have he' := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp he).2
  rw [eight_weyl_sum t a b d ha hb hd ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁ hD hW]
  exact ((eq_div_iff hW).mpr (by
    simpa [mul_comm] using weyl_target_cleared t a b d ha hb hd he')).symm

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weylClosed_div_poincare
statement:
theorem weylClosed_div_poincare (t a b d : K) :
    weylClosedExpression t a b d / poincare t = closedCore t a b d
proof:
:= by
  unfold weylClosedExpression closedCore
  rw [div_div]
  congr 1
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.gamma_substitution
statement:
theorem gamma_substitution (a b gamma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hgamma : a * b * gamma ^ 2 = 1) (i : Fin 8) :
    gamma ^ 2 * weylL a b i ^ 2 = weylU a b i
proof:
:= by
  have hg : gamma ^ 2 = (a * b)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← one_div]
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero ha hb)).mpr
    simpa [mul_comm] using hgamma
  rw [hg]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [weylL, weylU] <;> field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.satakeNumerator_eq

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principalAdjointInverse_eq
statement:

    principalAdjointInverse t d =
      (1 - d ^ 2 * t ^ 2) * (1 - t ^ 2) * (1 - t ^ 2 / d ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalAdjointInverse
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principal_cancellation
statement:
theorem principal_cancellation (t d p n₁ n₂ d₁ d₂ : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ ≠ 0) (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    (p * (1 - t ^ 2) * n₁ * n₂ / (poincare t * d₁ * d₂)) *
      ((1 - t ^ 4) * (1 - t ^ 8) * ((1 - d * t) * (1 - t / d) * d₁ * d₂) /
        ((1 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂ * principalAdjointInverse t d)) =
      p / ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalAdjointInverse
  generalize d * t = x at *
  generalize t / d = y at *
  field_simp
  simp only [poincare]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.normalized_closedCore_principal
statement:
theorem normalized_closedCore_principal (t a b d : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ t a b d ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ t a b d ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    closedCore t a b d * principalNormalizer t a b d =
      satakeNumerator a b / ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))
proof:
:=
  principal_cancellation t d (satakeNumerator a b) (n₁ t a b) (n₂ t a b)
    (d₁ t a b d) (d₂ t a b d) hc hn₁ hn₂ hd₁ hd₂ ht hm hp him hip

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_d₁
statement:

    d₁ t a b (-t) = fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2)

  unfold d₁
  congr 1
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_d₂
statement:

  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_cancellation
statement:
theorem special_negative_cancellation (t p n₁ n₂ f : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    (p * (1 - t ^ 2) * n₁ * n₂ / (poincare t * f * p)) *
      ((1 - t ^ 4) * (1 - t ^ 8) * ((1 + t ^ 2) * f) /
        ((1 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂ * (1 - t ^ 4))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  field_simp
  simp only [poincare]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.normalized_closedCore_special_negative
statement:
theorem normalized_closedCore_special_negative (t a b : K)
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : satakeNumerator a b ≠ 0)
    (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hf : fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    closedCore t a b (-t) * specialNormalizer t a b (-1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedCore specialNormalizer specialTensorInverse piAdjointInverse
  rw [special_negative_d₁, special_negative_d₂ t a b ht₀ ha hb]
  simp only [neg_one_mul, sub_neg_eq_add]
  exact special_negative_cancellation t (satakeNumerator a b) (n₁ t a b)
    (n₂ t a b) (fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2)) hc hp hn₁ hn₂ hf ht ht₄

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one {z x : ℂ}
    (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) : 1 - z * x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hh := congrArg norm (sub_eq_zero.mp he)
  simp only [norm_one, norm_mul, hz, one_mul] at hh
  linarith

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one {z x : ℂ}
    (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) : 1 + z * x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖-z‖ = 1 := by simpa using hz
  simpa using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hn hx

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.coe_norm_lt_one

    ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht₀] using ht₁

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principal_final_denominator_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coe_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁
  have hi : ‖d⁻¹‖ = 1 := by simp [hd]
  exact mul_ne_zero (one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hd hx)
    (by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
      one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hi hx)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.fourFactors_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hai : ‖a⁻¹‖ = 1 := by simp [ha]
  have hbi : ‖b⁻¹‖ = 1 := by simp [hb]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one ha hx)
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hai hx))
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hb hx))
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hbi hx)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.unit_satake_real

    a + 2 + a⁻¹ = ((2 + 2 * a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principal_final_denominator_normSq

    (1 + d * (t : ℂ)) * (1 + (t : ℂ) / d) =
      (Complex.normSq (1 + d * (t : ℂ)) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.mul_conj]
  congr 1
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, Complex.inv_eq_conj hd, mul_comm]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.inverseSqrt_pos

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.inverseSqrt_lt_one
statement: theorem inverseSqrt_lt_one {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) : inverseSqrt q < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 1 < Real.sqrt q := by
    have h := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
    have hnon := Real.sqrt_nonneg q
    nlinarith
  exact (inv_lt_one₀ (by linarith : 0 < Real.sqrt q)).mpr hs

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.inverseSqrt_sq
statement: theorem inverseSqrt_sq {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) : inverseSqrt q ^ 2 = q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [inverseSqrt, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hq]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.square_root_satake
statement:
theorem square_root_satake {K : Type*} [Field K] (a z : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hz : z ^ 2 = a) :
    (z⁻¹ + z) ^ 2 = a + 2 + a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hz₀ : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    apply ha
    rw [← hz, he]
    simp
  rw [← hz]
  field_simp
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.coe_pow_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem coe_pow_norm_lt_one {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t < 1)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : ‖(t : ℂ) ^ n‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_pow]
  exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (coe_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁) hn

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.poincare_coe_ne_zero
statement: theorem poincare_coe_ne_zero (t : ℝ) : poincare (t : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < poincare t := by unfold poincare; positivity
  have hc : poincare (t : ℂ) = ((poincare t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp [poincare]
  rw [hc]
  exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.n₂_unitary_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coe_pow_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hab : ‖a * b‖ = 1 := by simp [ha, hb]
  have hab' : ‖a / b‖ = 1 := by simp [ha, hb]
  have hba : ‖b / a‖ = 1 := by simp [ha, hb]
  have hi : ‖(a * b)⁻¹‖ = 1 := by simp [ha, hb]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
    (by simpa [mul_assoc] using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hab hx)
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hab' hx))
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hba hx))
    (one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hi hx)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weylU_unitary
statement:
theorem weylU_unitary {a b : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (i : Fin 8) :
    ‖weylU a b i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [weylU, ha, hb]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weylV_unitary
statement:
theorem weylV_unitary {a b : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (i : Fin 8) :
    ‖weylV a b i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [weylV, ha, hb]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.regionRegular_unitary
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coe_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁
  have hx₂ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hx₄ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁ (by decide : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hdV : ‖d * V‖ = 1 := by simp [hd, hV]
  have hVd : ‖V / d‖ = 1 := by simp [hd, hV]
  have hV₂ : ‖V ^ 2‖ = 1 := by simp [hV]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hdV hx
  · simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
      one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hVd hx
  · exact one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hV₂ hx₂
  · exact one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hU hx₂
  · exact one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hU hx₄

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finiteRegular_unitary
statement:
theorem finiteRegular_unitary {t : ℝ} {a b d : ℂ}
    (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t < 1) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) : FiniteRegular (t : ℂ) a b d
proof:
:= by
  have ha₀ := unit_ne_zero ha
  have hb₀ := unit_ne_zero hb
  have hd₀ := unit_ne_zero hd
  have hx := coe_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁
  have hdt : ‖d * (t : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by simpa [norm_mul, hd] using hx
  have htd : ‖(t : ℂ) / d‖ < 1 := by simpa [norm_div, hd] using hx
  have hD₁ : d₁ (t : ℂ) a b d ≠ 0 := fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb hdt
  have hD₂ : d₂ (t : ℂ) a b d ≠ 0 := fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb htd
  have hWall : weylWall a b ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha₁ hab) hb₁) hab₁
  refine ⟨ha₀, hb₀, hd₀, ha₁, hb₁, hab, hab₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [weyl_common_euler_factorization (t : ℂ) a b d ha₀ hb₀ hd₀]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hWall
        (pow_ne_zero 2 ha₀)) (pow_ne_zero 2 hb₀)) hd₀)
        (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 ha₀) (pow_ne_zero 2 hb₀))
          (pow_ne_zero 4 hd₀)))
      (mul_ne_zero hD₁ hD₂)
  · intro i
    exact regionRegular_unitary ht₀ ht₁ hd (weylU_unitary ha hb i) (weylV_unitary ha hb i)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_principal_unitary
statement:
theorem finite_principal_unitary (q t : ℝ) (a b d : ℂ)
    (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t < 1) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (t : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (t : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /
        ((1 + d * (t : ℂ)) * (1 + (t : ℂ) / d))
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coe_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁
  have hx₂ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one ht₀ ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hdi : ‖d⁻¹‖ = 1 := by simp [hd]
  have hdt : ‖d * (t : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by simpa [norm_mul, hd] using hx
  have htd : ‖(t : ℂ) / d‖ < 1 := by simpa [norm_div, hd] using hx
  apply finite_sum_principal_formula (q : ℂ) (t : ℂ) a b d
    (finiteRegular_unitary ht₀ ht₁ ha hb hd ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁)
    (poincare_coe_ne_zero t) (fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb hx₂)
    (n₂_unitary_ne_zero ht₀ ht₁ ha hb)
    (fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb hdt) (fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb htd)
  · simpa using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one (norm_one : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1) hx₂
  · exact one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hd hx
  · exact one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hd hx
  · simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hdi hx
  · simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hdi hx

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_principal_inverseSqrt
statement:
theorem finite_principal_inverseSqrt (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b d : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /
        ((1 + d * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) * (1 + (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) / d))
proof:
:=
  finite_principal_unitary q (inverseSqrt q) a b d
    (le_of_lt (inverseSqrt_pos hq)) (inverseSqrt_lt_one hq) ha hb hd ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_principal_square_roots
statement:
theorem finite_principal_square_roots (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b d A B : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (hA : A ^ 2 = a) (hB : B ^ 2 = b)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (A⁻¹ + A) ^ 2 * (B⁻¹ + B) ^ 2 /
        ((1 + d * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) * (1 + (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) / d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [square_root_satake a A (unit_ne_zero ha) hA,
    square_root_satake b B (unit_ne_zero hb) hB]
  exact finite_principal_inverseSqrt q hq a b d ha hb hd ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.one_add_inv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem one_add_inv_ne_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (h : 1 + z ≠ 0) :
    1 + z⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have he' := congrArg (fun x : ℂ => x * z) he
  apply h
  simpa [add_mul, hz, add_comm] using he'

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weylV_one_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem weylV_one_add_ne_zero {a b : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) (i : Fin 8) :
    1 + weylV a b i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hAi := one_add_inv_ne_zero ha hA
  have hBi := one_add_inv_ne_zero hb hB
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [weylV] using hA
  · simpa [weylV] using hB
  · simpa [weylV] using hA
  · simpa [weylV] using hBi
  · simpa [weylV] using hB
  · simpa [weylV] using hAi
  · simpa [weylV] using hBi
  · simpa [weylV] using hAi

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.satakeNumerator_unitary_ne_zero
statement:
theorem satakeNumerator_unitary_ne_zero {a b : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) : satakeNumerator a b ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hA) (pow_ne_zero 2 hB))
    (mul_ne_zero (unit_ne_zero ha) (unit_ne_zero hb))

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.regionRegular_special_negative
proof:
:= by
  have htne : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt ht₀
  have hx₂ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have base := regionRegular_unitary (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁
    (norm_one : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1) hU hV
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, base.e, base.f, base.g⟩
  · convert one_add_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one hV hx₂ using 1
    ring
  · have he : V * (t : ℂ) / (-(t : ℂ)) = -V := by
      rw [div_neg, mul_div_cancel_right₀ V htne]
    simpa [he] using hV₁

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finiteRegular_special_negative
statement:
theorem finiteRegular_special_negative {t : ℝ} {a b : ℂ}
    (ht₀ : 0 < t) (ht₁ : t < 1) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) :
    FiniteRegular (t : ℂ) a b (-(t : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have ha₀ := unit_ne_zero ha
  have hb₀ := unit_ne_zero hb
  have htne : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt ht₀
  have hd₀ : -(t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr htne
  have hx₂ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hf : fourFactors a b (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
    fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb (by simpa using hx₂)
  have hD₁ : d₁ (t : ℂ) a b (-(t : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [special_negative_d₁]
  have hD₂ : d₂ (t : ℂ) a b (-(t : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [special_negative_d₂ (t : ℂ) a b htne ha₀ hb₀]
    exact satakeNumerator_unitary_ne_zero ha hb hA hB
  have hWall : weylWall a b ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha₁ hab) hb₁) hab₁
  refine ⟨ha₀, hb₀, hd₀, ha₁, hb₁, hab, hab₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [weyl_common_euler_factorization (t : ℂ) a b (-(t : ℂ)) ha₀ hb₀ hd₀]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hWall
        (pow_ne_zero 2 ha₀)) (pow_ne_zero 2 hb₀)) hd₀)
        (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 ha₀) (pow_ne_zero 2 hb₀))
          (pow_ne_zero 4 hd₀)))
      (mul_ne_zero hD₁ hD₂)
  · intro i
    exact regionRegular_special_negative ht₀ ht₁ (weylU_unitary ha hb i)
      (weylV_unitary ha hb i) (weylV_one_add_ne_zero ha₀ hb₀ hA hB i)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_special_negative_unitary
statement:
theorem finite_special_negative_unitary (q t : ℝ) (a b : ℂ)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t) (ht₁ : t < 1) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (t : ℂ) a b (-(t : ℂ))) *
      specialNormalizer (t : ℂ) a b (-1) = 2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htne : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt ht₀
  have hx₂ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁ (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hx₄ := coe_pow_norm_lt_one (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁ (by decide : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  apply finite_sum_special_negative_formula (q : ℂ) (t : ℂ) a b
    (finiteRegular_special_negative ht₀ ht₁ ha hb ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁ hA hB)
    htne (poincare_coe_ne_zero t) (satakeNumerator_unitary_ne_zero ha hb hA hB)
    (fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb hx₂) (n₂_unitary_ne_zero (le_of_lt ht₀) ht₁ ha hb)
    (fourFactors_ne_zero ha hb (by simpa using hx₂))
  · simpa using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one (norm_one : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1) hx₂
  · simpa using one_sub_mul_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one (norm_one : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1) hx₄

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_special_negative_inverseSqrt
statement:
theorem finite_special_negative_inverseSqrt (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b (-(inverseSqrt q : ℂ))) *
      specialNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b (-1) = 2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1)
proof:
:=
  finite_special_negative_unitary q (inverseSqrt q) a b
    (inverseSqrt_pos hq) (inverseSqrt_lt_one hq) ha hb ha₁ hb₁ hab hab₁ hA hB

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.coefficientIdentity7
statement: theorem coefficientIdentity7 (t a b : K) : wc0_7 t a b + wc1_7 t a b + wc2_7 t a b + wc3_7 t a b + wc4_7 t a b + wc5_7 t a b + wc6_7 t a b + wc7_7 t a b = 0
proof:
:= by

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finiteCore_eq_closedCore
statement:
theorem finiteCore_eq_closedCore (t a b d : K) (h : FiniteRegular t a b d) :
    finiteCore t a b d = closedCore t a b d
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (i : Fin 8) :
      weylWeights t a b i *
        (∑ j : Fin 50, regionTerms t d (weylU a b i) (weylV a b i) j) =
        weylTerms t a b d i := by
    rw [fifty_region_sum t d (weylU a b i) (weylV a b i)
      h.d_ne_zero (h.rows i).p (h.rows i).n (h.rows i).e (h.rows i).f (h.rows i).g]
    rfl
  have hD (i : Fin 8) : weylKernelDenominator t a b d i ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 h.d_ne_zero) (h.rows i).p) (h.rows i).n
  calc
    finiteCore t a b d = (∑ i : Fin 8, weylTerms t a b d i) / poincare t := by
      unfold finiteCore
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i)
    _ = closedCore t a b d := by
      rw [eight_weyl_sum_closed t a b d h.a_ne_zero h.b_ne_zero h.d_ne_zero
        h.a_ne_one h.b_ne_one h.a_ne_b h.ab_ne_one hD h.common]
      exact weylClosed_div_poincare t a b d

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_sum_principal_formula
statement:
theorem finite_sum_principal_formula (q t a b d : K)
    (h : FiniteRegular t a b d)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ t a b d ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ t a b d ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    (2 / (q + 1) * finiteCore t a b d) * principalNormalizer t a b d =
      2 / (q + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /
        ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteCore_eq_closedCore t a b d h, mul_assoc,
    normalized_closedCore_principal t a b d hc hn₁ hn₂ hd₁ hd₂ ht hm hp him hip,
    satakeNumerator_eq a b h.a_ne_zero h.b_ne_zero]
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_sum_special_negative_formula
statement:
theorem finite_sum_special_negative_formula (q t a b : K)
    (h : FiniteRegular t a b (-t))
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : satakeNumerator a b ≠ 0)
    (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hf : fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / (q + 1) * finiteCore t a b (-t)) * specialNormalizer t a b (-1) =
      2 / (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteCore_eq_closedCore t a b (-t) h, mul_assoc,
    normalized_closedCore_special_negative t a b ht₀ h.a_ne_zero h.b_ne_zero
      hc hp hn₁ hn₂ hf ht ht₄, mul_one]

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_sum_special_positive_formula
statement:

    ((1 - (1 : K)) / (q + 1) * finiteCore t a b t) * specialNormalizer t a b 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: FourierJacobi.intertwinerMatrix_at_endpoint
statement:
theorem intertwinerMatrix_at_endpoint (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 1) :
    intertwinerMatrix q q⁻¹ = !![q⁻¹, 1; q⁻¹, 1]
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 1 - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (inv_ne_one.mpr hq))
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [intertwinerMatrix, hr]

name: FourierJacobi.endpoint_kills_specialVector
statement:
theorem endpoint_kills_specialVector (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 1) :
    (intertwinerMatrix q q⁻¹).mulVec (specialVector q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [intertwinerMatrix_at_endpoint q hq]
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [specialVector, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: FourierJacobi.endpoint_kernel
statement:
theorem endpoint_kernel (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 1) (v : Fin 2 → K) :
    (intertwinerMatrix q q⁻¹).mulVec v = 0 ↔ v 1 = -q⁻¹ * v 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [intertwinerMatrix_at_endpoint q hq]
  simp [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

name: FourierJacobi.compactGram_special_norm_sq
statement:
theorem compactGram_special_norm_sq (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) :
    dotProduct (specialVector q) ((compactGram q).mulVec (specialVector q)) = q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hq1 : q + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  simp [specialVector, compactGram, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  field_simp

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.region_numerators_sum
statement:
theorem region_numerators_sum (t d U V : K) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 50, rawRegionNumerators t d U V
      (1 - d * V * t) (1 - V * t / d)
      (1 - V ^ 2 * t ^ 2) (1 - U * t ^ 2) (1 - U * t ^ 4) i) =
    (1 - V ^ 2 * t ^ 2) * (1 - U * t ^ 2) * (1 - U * t ^ 4) *
      kernelNumerator t d U V

:= by
  rw [raw_numerators_sum]
  unfold rawNumeratorSum kernelNumerator
  field_simp
  ring

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.fifty_region_sum
statement:
theorem fifty_region_sum (t d U V : K) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hP : 1 - d * V * t ≠ 0) (hN : 1 - V * t / d ≠ 0)
    (hE : 1 - V ^ 2 * t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hF : 1 - U * t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hG : 1 - U * t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 50, regionTerms t d U V i) = regionKernel t d U V
proof:
:= by
  let P := 1 - d * V * t
  let N := 1 - V * t / d
  let E := 1 - V ^ 2 * t ^ 2
  let F := 1 - U * t ^ 2
  let G := 1 - U * t ^ 4
  have hh := region_numerators_sum t d U V hd
  have hs : (d ^ 2 * P * N * E * F * G) *
      (∑ i : Fin 50, regionTerms t d U V i) =
      E * F * G * kernelNumerator t d U V := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 50, rawRegionNumerators t d U V P N E F G i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact region_term_cleared t d U V P N E F G hd hP hN hE hF hG i
      _ = _ := hh
  have hden : d ^ 2 * P * N * E * F * G ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hd) hP) hN) hE) hF) hG
  apply (mul_right_inj' hden).mp
  rw [hs]
  change E * F * G * kernelNumerator t d U V =
    (d ^ 2 * P * N * E * F * G) * (kernelNumerator t d U V / (d ^ 2 * P * N))
  have hpn : d ^ 2 * P * N ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hd) hP) hN
  have hcancel (x y z : K) (hy : y ≠ 0) : y * z * (x / y) = z * x := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  simpa [mul_assoc] using
    (hcancel (kernelNumerator t d U V) (d ^ 2 * P * N) (E * F * G) hpn).symm

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.weyl_polynomial_identity
statement:
theorem weyl_polynomial_identity (t a b d : K) :
    (∑ i : Fin 8, weylClearedTerms t a b d i) = weylTargetNumerator t a b d
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [clearedExpansion, evalCoefficients]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, coefficientIdentity]
  have ht : weylTargetNumerator t a b d = weylTargetCoefficient t a b * d ^ 5 := by
    unfold weylTargetNumerator weylTargetCoefficient
